name: AT&T
notes: AT&T uses a 2-step login: (1) User ID (email/username) field → Continue button, (2) Password field → Sign in button. MFA was not triggered during exploration but AT&T may send verification codes in some scenarios — MFA detection is included. After login a feedback popup ('We'd love your feedback') may appear — dismiss with 'No thanks'. A 'myAT&T app' banner may appear at the bottom of the login page — dismiss with the X button. The billing center URL is /acctmgmt/billing/mybillingcenter and shows 'Current balance' with 'Total due on [date]' and the dollar amount prominently. The Make a Payment page allows changing amount and selecting from saved bank accounts; the default is pre-selected.

billPullSteps.description: Wait for login page to load
Dismiss myAT&T app banner if present
billPullSteps.instruction: If a 'myAT&T app' banner is visible at the bottom of the screen, click the X button on the left side to dismiss it
Type "{{username}}" into the User ID input field

billPullSteps.description: Click Continue to proceed to password page
Wait for password page to load
Click Sign in to submit credentials
billPullSteps.instruction: Click the blue Sign in button

billPullSteps.description: Wait for account to load (may show MFA or dashboard)

billPullSteps.instruction: Look for any verification code prompt, MFA challenge, 'Confirm your identity', 'Enter the code we sent', or any security code entry field
If a 'We'd love your feedback after your visit today' popup is visible, click 'No thanks' to dismiss it

billPullSteps.description: Click Billing in the account navigation to do a client-side route change (avoids SPA auth loss)
billPullSteps.instruction: Click the 'Billing' icon or link in the top account navigation menu bar (between Payments and Profile)

billPullSteps.description: Wait for billing center SPA content to load
Extract balance and due date from billing center
billPullSteps.instruction: Extract the current balance amount and the payment due date from the 'My billing center' page. Look for 'Current balance' section showing the dollar amount and 'Total due on [date]' text.

billPaySteps.description: Navigate to AT&T sign-in page
Wait for login page to load
Dismiss myAT&T app banner if present
billPaySteps.instruction: If a 'myAT&T app' banner is visible at the bottom of the screen, click the X button on the left side to dismiss it

billPaySteps.description: Enter User ID (Step 1 of 2-step login)
billPaySteps.instruction: Type "{{username}}" into the User ID input field

billPaySteps.description: Click Continue to proceed to password page
Wait for password page to load
Enter password (Step 2 of 2-step login)
Click Sign in to submit credentials
billPaySteps.instruction: Click the blue Sign in button

billPaySteps.description: Wait for account to load (may show MFA or dashboard)
Check for MFA verification prompt
billPaySteps.instruction: Look for any verification code prompt, MFA challenge, 'Confirm your identity', 'Enter the code we sent', or any security code entry field

billPaySteps.description: Dismiss feedback popup if present
billPaySteps.instruction: If a 'We'd love your feedback after your visit today' popup is visible, click 'No thanks' to dismiss it

billPaySteps.description: Click Billing in the account navigation to do a client-side route change (avoids SPA auth loss)
billPaySteps.instruction: Click the 'Billing' icon or link in the top account navigation menu bar (between Payments and Profile)

billPaySteps.description: Wait for billing center SPA content to load
Click Other payment options to open Make a Payment page
billPaySteps.instruction: Click the 'Other payment options' button below the PAY NOW button in the Current balance section

billPaySteps.description: Wait for Make a Payment page to load
Clear and enter the payment amount
billPaySteps.instruction: Click on the 'Enter amount' field, clear the existing value, and type "{{payment_amount}}"

billPaySteps.description: Scroll down to see payment method and submit button
billPaySteps.instruction: Scroll down to see the 'Pay with' section showing the selected bank account and find the Continue or Review payment button

billPaySteps.description: Submit the payment
billPaySteps.instruction: Click the 'Continue' or 'Review payment' or 'Submit payment' button to proceed with the payment using the pre-selected bank account

billPaySteps.description: Wait for payment review or confirmation page
Confirm the payment if a review step is shown
billPaySteps.instruction: If a payment review page is shown, click the 'Submit payment', 'Pay now', or 'Confirm' button to finalize the payment

billPaySteps.description: Wait for payment confirmation
Extract payment confirmation details
billPaySteps.instruction: Extract the payment confirmation details. Look for a confirmation number, amount paid, and payment date.

mfaDetection.observeInstruction: Look for any page asking for a verification code, 'Confirm your identity', 'Enter the code we sent you', or any field requesting a security code sent via SMS or email
